answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 961 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the kernel. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the sable queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier goes on earning. The knoll index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A farm of 251 pays that 87 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
